description.value: Powder Hounds is the oldest privately owned restaurant at Sun Peaks Resort, having served guests since 1998. The kitchen offers international cuisine with a distinctly German flair — schnitzel and spaetzle feature alongside fresh seafood, pasta, and a rotating menu of daily-prepared dishes. Cyclists finishing a ride in the Sun Peaks area can choose between 65 indoor seats or a 45-seat sunny patio with mountain views and a herb garden.
